description: This Java class, FinalPrice, models the price information for a product in an e-commerce catalog, including discounted price, original price, final price, discount details, and associated product price.

classes.name: FinalPrice
classes.description: A transient entity used to display various price information such as discounted price, original price, discount percentage, and associated product price.

methods.name: getAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Returns the list of additional prices associated with this price instance.

methods.name: setAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Sets the list of additional prices.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Returns the original price before any discounts.

methods.name: getDiscountEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the discount period.

methods.name: setDiscountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the discount period.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Checks if the price is discounted.

methods.name: setDiscounted
methods.description: Sets whether the price is discounted.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Marks whether this is the default price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Checks if this is the default price.

methods.name: setProductPrice
methods.description: Associates a ProductPrice object with this price.
